headline: Unbeaten Lincoln go to Drury level on points
dek: Lincoln arrive with a match in hand and still without a defeat, ten wins and four draws in all, after beating Missouri S&T on Wednesday. Drury have not lost at home in conference play, but Indianapolis, Rockhurst and Maryville have each left with a draw.
displaced_by: Lincoln beat Missouri S&T, so the standing dek's nine-win record is no longer true, and the two leaders now meet at Drury.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Southwest Baptist have scored forty-two goals, more than either Drury or Lincoln at the top, but they have conceded thirty-two and lost six times; the leaders have built their place at the other end of the pitch.

wire.line: Whichever of Drury and Lincoln wins at Drury goes clear at the top of the table; a draw leaves them level.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Two matches past their date carry no result, and both are Drury's, one at home and one away, both from August.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Drury have conceded eleven goals and lost twice, at home to Oklahoma Christian in August and away at Missouri S&T in September.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Jonathan Nemorden, a freshman, has eleven of Lincoln's twenty-nine goals, from fifty-five shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Truman have scored twenty-three goals and conceded twenty-four, and Jacob Panagos has thirteen of the twenty-three from forty-six shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Noah Nymark-Pedersen has made seventy-three saves for Upper Iowa and conceded thirty-three, a save percentage of .689.

last_match.line: Lincoln are still without a defeat, and Missouri S&T, who beat Drury in September, could not do the same to them.

next_match.line: No side in the conference has conceded fewer goals than Lincoln, and only Lincoln have conceded fewer than Drury.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
